title: From R code to evidence
subtitle: A reproducible pathway through statistics, learning analytics, and educational data mining.
outcomes: Frame a data question and identify an evidence boundary.
Run and explain a reproducible R transformation.
Use a visual or tabular representation to support a claim.
Transfer the reasoning to a new observation and document the result.

modules.title: Make a data claim
modules.description: Learn the R-LearnXR loop: predict, run a real R transformation, select evidence, and explain a limitation.

modules.title: Find structure with PCA
modules.description: Standardize penguin measurements, inspect principal components, and defend what a multivariate coordinate does and does not mean.

modules.title: Explain efficiency patterns
modules.description: Compare vehicle observations across weight, power, and efficiency while separating association from a causal claim.

modules.title: From event to learning construct
modules.description: Translate an event log into a transparent construct, audit missingness, and choose a learner-safe descriptive summary.

modules.title: Discover patterns responsibly
modules.description: Compare clustering and prediction as discovery tools, then document uncertainty, fairness, and intervention limits.
